movers.text: Starter Neo Avdalas (24 mpg, team-high 3.8 apg) fractured his left wrist vs. Georgia and had surgery; UNC says he is out about two months (announced 11/17).
Louisville's Seth Trimble (28 mpg) missed the Stetson win with a minor injury; Pat Kelsey said on 11/23 he is on track to play in the Players Era opener vs Texas Tech.
Tennessee's Jalen Haralson (20.5 mpg, right knee hyperextension 11/17) sat out Coastal Carolina; MRI showed swelling only, and Rick Barnes thinks he will be ready for Maryland on 11/24.
Syracuse PG Garwey Dual (24.2 mpg) hurt his right ankle vs Lafayette on 11/21 and sat the second half in a walking boot; X-rays ordered, no status yet for UAlbany on 11/25.
